title: Limited diversity in generated shapes
description: Generations with SDI exhibit a certain degree of diversity in local details, but are mostly the same at a coarse level. The authors state they plan to address this problem in future research.
canonical_description: limited coarse-level diversity in score-distilled 3D generations across seeds
